title: Prove remote sign-in live and document it
description:
Prove the whole flow live and document it.

1. From a machine with no browser and no keyring, start the memory agent and run `prospectus login --remote --as <person>`. Send the person the URL and code.
2. After approval, run `prospectus whoami` and the CRM read.
3. Check renewal: after the access token expires, a command still works without a new approval.
4. Run `prospectus logout` and confirm the refresh token is revoked.

Write `docs/cli-remote-login.md` covering usage, the trust model, what is throttled, and how the broker and pages versions are kept in step. Add dated proof to docs/OPERATIONS.md. Never print or commit tokens.

Done when: Ryan has approved a live remote login and the doc is merged.
